data.description:
# Swarm has no audio (AH-0MTCO1L74003CAQJ)

**Headline:** The E5 Swarm enemy is silent on both of its player-facing events — coordinated burst firing and destruction. Add the shared destruction sound, a new Swarm-specific burst fire sound (single sound per volley), and a pre-fire advance audio cue, following the existing procedural-audio pattern.

## Problem statement

The E5 Swarm enemy (`src/entities/Swarm.ts`) plays no audio on either of its two player-facing events: coordinated burst firing (`tryFireBurstBullet`) and destruction (`destroySelf`/`playExplosion`). The E4 Phaser entity already plays a destruction sound and a firing advance cue; the Swarm breaks the GDD §7.3 audio-feedback design and is inconsistent with its peers.

## Users

- **Players** — need audible feedback when a swarm member explodes (shot-landed confirmation) and when a coordinated burst is imminent/occurs (danger cue) per GDD §7.3.
- **AI agents / developers implementing AI_Hell** — need Swarm audio to follow the established procedural-audio pattern (`src/audio/effects.ts`) so headless tests stay green and the enemy core-library best practices apply.

### Example user stories

- As a player, I want to hear a sound when a swarm member explodes so I get feedback that my shot landed.
- As a player, I want an audio cue before and during a coordinated swarm burst so I can react to the danger.
- As a developer, I want Swarm audio implemented via the existing `effects.ts` helpers so it degrades to a safe no-op in headless tests.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **Destruction sound** — Destroying a Swarm member plays the shared `playDestructionSound()` exactly once per destruction (reusing the existing sound; the implementer must avoid double-play with the base scene's scene-level call in `GymFormationScene.explodeRandom()`).
- **Swarm burst fire sound** — A new Swarm-specific fire sound exists in `src/audio/effects.ts` (a buzzing/whoosh character distinct from the destruction blip, e.g. `playSwarmBurstSound()`).
- **Single sound per volley** — A coordinated burst volley plays the Swarm burst sound exactly **once** per volley (volley-level, not per entity), verified via a test using a mocked/spied effects module.
- **Advance audio cue** — Swarm plays a firing advance audio cue ≥ 500 ms before each coordinated burst volley (mirroring the Phaser advance-cue pattern), verified for ordering relative to the burst sound.
- **Safe degradation** — All new audio calls are safe no-ops without a working `AudioContext` (headless tests, browsers without Web Audio), preserving the `effects.ts` contract.
- **Documentation** — All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` if it lists per-enemy audio behavior.
- **Full project test suite must pass** with the new changes.

## Constraints

- Procedural Web Audio only — no audio assets (existing `effects.ts` pattern).
- Follow enemy core-library best practices (`docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md`); the base `GymFormationScene` already plays spawn/destruction sounds for all enemy gyms — the implementer must reconcile entity-level vs scene-level audio to avoid double-play.
- Audio functions must degrade to safe no-ops in headless environments.
- Do not include CI/CD pipeline tests.

## Existing state

- `src/entities/Swarm.ts` — `playExplosion()` and `tryFireBurstBullet()` are silent; no audio imports.
- `src/audio/effects.ts` — has `playSpawnSound`, `playDestructionSound`, `playTankDestructionSound`, and power-up/weapon cues; **no enemy fire sound exists**.
- `src/entities/Phaser.ts` (reference) — `playExplosion()` calls `playDestructionSound()`; `applyFormationPosition` plays a pre-fire advance cue via `_playAdvanceCue()` (≥ 500 ms lead, rising sine 660→880 Hz).
- `src/scenes/gym/core/GymFormationScene.ts` — base class plays `playSpawnSound()` at spawn and `playDestructionSound()` in `explodeRandom()` for all enemy gyms (design doc §6 says these are base-class-owned).

## Desired change

- **Swarm entity**: play the shared destruction sound on destruction (Q1: reuse `playDestructionSound()`).
- **New sound**: add a unique Swarm fire sound to `effects.ts` (Q2b: buzzing/whoosh to match the swarm aesthetic).
- **Volley orchestration**: play the burst sound exactly once per coordinated volley (Q3: single volley-level sound) — e.g. in the `GymSwarm` scene's `collectBullets` when any member fires in a frame.
- **Advance cue**: add a firing advance audio cue ≥ 500 ms before each burst (Q4: yes), mirroring the Phaser pattern.

**Key Files:**

- `src/entities/Swarm.ts` — add destruction sound to `destroySelf()`/`playExplosion()`; add advance-cue and fire-sound hooks in the burst-firing path.
- `src/audio/effects.ts` — add `playSwarmBurstSound()` (and the Swarm advance-cue tone helper if needed).
- `src/scenes/gym/GymSwarm.ts` — orchestrate the single volley-level burst sound (e.g. in `collectBullets`) and any volley advance cue.
- `src/scenes/gym/core/GymFormationScene.ts` — reconcile scene-level `playDestructionSound()` with the new entity-level sound to avoid double-play.
- `src/entities/Swarm.test.ts` — destruction-audio, volley-sound-once, and advance-cue-ordering tests (spy/mock the `effects` module).
- `src/scenes/gym/GymSwarm.test.ts` — scene-level volley audio orchestration tests.
- `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` — update audio guidance if it lists per-enemy sound behavior.
- `src/audio/effects.ts` — new sound helpers (see above).

## Related work

- **Create E5 Swarm gym scene (AH-0MT99N53O0077KHC)** — completed; the scene and entity that needs the audio.
- **Update E4/E5/Boss work items to adhere to core-library best practices (AH-0MTAN51HO007A92H)** — completed; established the `effects.ts` audio pattern and the `GymFormationScene` base-class audio ownership.
- **Write ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md best-practice guide (AH-0MTAN4X5D009D7U6)** — completed; §6 documents audio ownership ("handled by the base class").
- **Swarm enemies are too small (AH-0MTCO1LA8004B7ZF)** — open, sibling; same enemy but unrelated scope.

## Risks & assumptions

- **Double-play risk (high)**: the base `GymFormationScene.explodeRandom()` already plays `playDestructionSound()`. If the Swarm entity also plays it, the gym scene double-plays. The implementer must ensure the destruction sound fires exactly once (either rely on the base class per design doc §6, or mirror the Phaser entity pattern and adjust the scene call). Assumption: producer's "yes" means the Swarm *should* have destruction audio; the once-only guarantee is the AC that resolves the ambiguity.
- **Advance-cue mechanics**: Phaser uses a two-phase tell state machine; Swarm's equivalent must be designed (tell phase vs. timed cue). Assumption: mirror Phaser's ≥ 500 ms lead-time pattern, adapted to Swarm's 900 ms burst interval.
- **Testability**: existing enemy tests do not exercise audio; new tests will spy/mock `src/audio/effects` to assert call counts/ordering in headless runs.
- **Scope creep**: no other audio work for Scout/Diver/Tank is implied (pre-existing gaps are out of scope; record separately if discovered).

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

- **Q1**: Should Swarm reuse the shared destruction sound (`playDestructionSound()`) or have a distinct one? — **Answer (producer): "yes"** — reuse the shared destruction sound. Source: interactive reply 2026-08-29.
- **Q2**: Should Swarm have a fire sound, and which kind? — **Answer (producer): "b"** — a unique Swarm-specific fire sound (e.g., a buzzing/whoosh to match the swarm aesthetic), added to `src/audio/effects.ts`. Source: interactive reply 2026-08-29.
- **Q3**: Fire-sound granularity — per entity or per volley? — **Answer (producer): "single"** — one volley-level sound per coordinated burst; the scene orchestrates it once per volley. Source: interactive reply 2026-08-29.
- **Q4**: Should Swarm also have a firing advance audio cue (like Phaser's ≥ 500 ms lead)? — **Answer (producer): "yes"** — add a firing advance cue in addition to the fire sound. Source: interactive reply 2026-08-29.

**Research summary**: Inspected `src/entities/Swarm.ts` (silent explosion + burst firing), `src/entities/Phaser.ts` (reference pattern: `playDestructionSound()` in `playExplosion()`, `_playAdvanceCue()` 660→880 Hz rising sine over 600 ms), `src/audio/effects.ts` (no fire sound exists; destruction/spawn/power-up sounds all follow the `blip()` envelope helper), `src/scenes/gym/core/GymFormationScene.ts` (scene-level `playSpawnSound()`/`playDestructionSound()` owned by the base class), and `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` §6 (audio handled by the base class — do not re-add). No existing enemy-fire sound exists anywhere in the codebase, so AC2 requires a new helper.
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **AH-0MT7O8KCY0059RA5** – Game Design Document for AI_Hell (completed)
- **AH-0MTAN4X5D009D7U6** – Write ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md best-practice guide (completed)
- **AH-0MTC2P6G3007PJ40** – Create combat gym scene for combat-coupled power-ups (P3 Shield, P4 Bomb, P6 Phase Shift, P7 Teleport) with low-level enemy threats (open)

### Repository file matches
- `README.md` — matched: audio, enemy, explode, fire, swarm
- `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` — matched: audio, enemy, explode, fire, swarm
- `docs/Game Design Document.md` — matched: audio, enemy, fire, swarm
